missingSecret.whatNoName: This needs an API key first.
missingSecret.why: The key is not set yet.

network.what: The dashboard could not reach the server.
network.why: It may have stopped or restarted.

unknownTool.why: Its pack may be off or removed.

auth.whatNoName: The service did not accept the key.
auth.why: It may be wrong, expired or missing a permission.

credit.what: {name} says the account is out of credit.
credit.whatNoName: The service says the account is out of credit.
credit.why: Add credit with the provider, then try again.

rateLimited.what: The service is rate limiting requests.
rateLimited.why: Wait a minute, then try again.

timeout.what: The service took too long to answer.
timeout.why: Try again; long jobs may need a smaller input.

serverError.what: The service had a problem on its side.
serverError.why: This is usually temporary. Try again shortly.

noProvider.what: No service is set up for this.
noProvider.why: Add a key for one that can do it.
